task_name: Combo Fighter UA Scale-Readiness Decision Pack (HOLD)
authoring_notes: Process only where Outcomes cannot prove required ordering/consult: Confluence individual reads before pack write, and workbook tab-list before select.

rubrics.criterion: The Agent consults the Combo Fighter Game Design Document and each of the six cross-check pages as individual page reads before writing the decision pack, rather than answering from search snippets.
rubrics.justification: The prompt forbids snippet-only evidence. Outcomes score the findings; only trajectory shows each page was consulted before the pack write.
rubrics.evidence: Before the Decision Pack write, the trajectory shows the Agent opened/read the GDD and each of the six cross-check pages individually. Answering any of those from a search-result list alone fails.

rubrics.criterion: The Agent lists the Combo Fighter Design Details tabs before selecting which tabs to open for the pack.
rubrics.justification: The prompt requires listing every tab before deciding which matter. No Outcome can prove that list-before-select order.
rubrics.evidence: Trajectory shows a tab listing for Combo Fighter Design Details before the Agent opens Versions, LevelDetails, Silver Economy, or Permanent Upgrades.
